review_notes.evidence: All nine native tiles and eight focused stage/field/terminal/footer crops independently read. Eleven physical gates, one input per gate; each delay pin is explicitly represented, including output pins on box top rows. Native captions start one cell after border. Owner final full preview review later completed; independent review completed and accepted.

Every named timing tap has a separate physical driver: AB4, AC1-7, AD1-7, AE1-6, AF1-7, AG1-6 and AH1-4. AG.D09 is a separate local return driving AK.D10 and AH.D09. AH auxiliary output on card-field row83, below B03, independently drives terminal AJ; it is not commoned with B03. Only AL.D12 has a printed output star.

Measured local bank4 border x5064.5 and bank5 x5993.5 imply approximately40.4 pixels per text cell. Native AC turn5557/c131, AD turn5516.5/c130, AE branch5635.5/c133, AF turn6432/c153 and AG turn6430.5/c153. Native local returns92/115/131/138/161 independently traced. Normal block banks retained.

AB and AJ function captions print R T with no numeral; retained exactly. First TD third output is D07, not a fabricated B06. Footer LOG865/SDD BLK.AM/P.N.2585615 and wrapped connector02A-A1N7D03 are read directly. Source visible short scanning gaps along wires retain their collinear continuity; no new diamond inserted.

Complete JuliaMono preview compared with native full page, nine overlapping native tiles and focused source crops. All43 distinct physical outputs, 38 negative named timing taps, AL4 positive wrap output, eleven input owners, port top-row placements, stage branches, unjoined crossings and AH separate auxiliary terminal route agree. Owner full preview review complete; independent review completed and accepted.
